**Task complete.**

The issue was a mutable default argument bug. The original code used `bucket=[]`, which meant all calls shared the same list object. When `test_isolated_again()` called `collect("b")`, it appended to the list that already contained `"a"` from the previous call, returning `["a", "b"]` instead of the expected `["b"]`.

The fix uses `None` as the default and creates a fresh list for each call that doesn't provide a bucket argument. Both tests now pass.
